bio: This splendid family business has seen successive generations of the Allemoz dynasty at the helm since 1895. Treat yourself to a chicken liver pâté with onion jam, grilled hanger steak or calf’s head with a ravigote sauce. Bistro classics also depict the dessert lineup, with regressive dishes like rum baba or île flottante. An enticing wine list adds the final cherry to this appetising programme....
